data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-t-l', meaning 'daughter of a nobleman'. In Islamic tradition, it is considered a beautiful and classic name for a baby girl. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Batoul usually hope their child will grow to embody daughter of a nobleman and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_urdu.name: بتول
